units.function: Unit tests for persisted dev supervisor status parsing/projection and sibling restart-request writing.
units.dependencyDirection: Real temporary JSON files feed pure/status helper functions; no supervisor process runs.
units.keyDataModels: Dirty/changed path/migration/restart timestamps, auto-restart and active-run state, restart request reason/time.
units.lifecycle: Read/normalize bounded status, project restart/waiting state and write a manual request file.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 4/4. File-size bounding and cleanup are useful; schema/type/range/time, ownership/mode/link, atomicity/concurrency, expiry/ack/result and active-work continuity are absent.
units.designRationale: Let a local dev supervisor communicate hot-reload state through dependency-free files.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS development tooling may need fast local restart feedback, but production control/execution planes require authenticated durable commands.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT only for a separately packaged dev profile. Add adversarial filesystem and request lifecycle tests, and prove the endpoint/protocol is absent or disabled in production builds/profiles.
units.responsibilityConflict: The test protocol has no human actor, approval, exact state/action digest or evidence that active Agent work was preserved.

units.function: Route tests for token-gated dev diagnostics and local/authenticated restart access.
units.dependencyDirection: Environment token/status files and fake actors/DB feed the real health router over Supertest.
units.keyDataModels: Dev status token, anonymous actor, deployment mode, devServer health projection and restart request response/file.
units.lifecycle: Present a supervisor token to read details; request restart anonymously in local_trusted; deny anonymous restart in authenticated mode.
units.testAssessment: Approved unsandboxed focused Vitest passed 3/3 with isolated PAPERCLIP_HOME. It omits incorrect/rotated/replayed token cases, Agent/ordinary-board authority, CSRF, production gating, idempotency and file/evidence safety.
units.designRationale: Allow an external dev runner to inspect authenticated-mode status while preserving a basic anonymous production boundary.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs strict separation between developer convenience credentials and customer-facing identity/authorization.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE_ONLY. Build explicit tests that dev tokens cannot authorize control actions, ordinary humans/Agents cannot restart, and all dev endpoints are profile/build gated away from production.
units.responsibilityConflict: Authenticated mode checks only board-vs-none, not accountable authority; local trusted mode permits anonymous process mutation with no evidence.
evidence: 2026-08-18 approved unsandboxed focused Vitest with isolated PAPERCLIP_HOME: 3/3 passed

units.function: Unversioned filesystem protocol for dev supervisor status and restart request plus a health projection.
units.dependencyDirection: An environment-selected status path is synchronously read; a fixed sibling path is created/overwritten for control; parsed state feeds health API.
units.lifecycle: Read/normalize supervisor state, derive restart reason/waiting state and overwrite a restart request for external consumption.
units.testAssessment: Helper tests pass but do not cover the production-critical filesystem and request lifecycle gaps visible in source.
units.designRationale: Use a simple language/runtime-neutral bridge between the server and a local dev process supervisor.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs local development ergonomics without allowing informal file protocols to become production execution authority.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE_ONLY as dev tooling. A production restart must use a versioned authenticated command/operation with idempotency, actor/approval, exact runtime/config digest, expiry, drain/adoption proof, result and immutable audit evidence.
units.responsibilityConflict: The request records only time and a constant reason; there is no accountable human, action target, approved state, work impact or completion evidence.
